body.label: Trigger
body.html: You are targeted by a supernatural Action.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Gain +1 Defense against the triggering Action. If it is maintained by Concentration, a Rite, or a manifestation, the source also suffers -1 Defense until the start of its next turn.

surges.html: Increase a Defense bonus granted by this Reaction by 1.
If the triggering effect is supernatural, reduce one Defense or bonus it grants by 1 for this resolution.
